form:FormGroup.label: Quick Settings
form:FormGroup.helpText: Preset time ranges, grouped as Relative, Present, Past and All. Select one to fill in both times.

form:FormGroup.label: After Time (inclusive)
form:FormGroup.helpText: Start of the time range; this time is included. Enter a date and time such as 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z, or an expression such as now()-1d or day(). Leave blank for no start limit.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Date and time, or e.g. now()-1d. Blank means no start limit.

form:FormGroup.label: Before Time (exclusive)
form:FormGroup.helpText: End of the time range; this time is not included. Enter a date and time such as 2026-01-02T00:00:00.000Z, or an expression such as now() or day(). Leave blank for no end limit.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Date and time, or e.g. now(). Blank means no end limit.
